name: Sloth
desc: Blissed-out soft-felt sloth grooving at half tempo — hangs from a leafy branch in a lazy pendulum sway, slow-motion disco points, drowsy blinks, and a butterfly friend its eyes follow.

speed.doc: rate multiplier — the sloth runs at HALF of this

y.doc: anchor y: branch grip for hang, feet for ground poses

sleepy.doc: eyelid droop: 0 wide awake, 1 blissfully gone

pose.doc: hang from branch / seated hug / slow-motion wave / half-tempo disco

style.doc: aesthetic: fuzzy felt+stitches / paper line-art+hatch / dark glow rims / soft pastel+blush
